entries.subject: Publisher optical display image
entries.finding: publisher publication JPEG. Selected for image-layer display. The 68 by 57 arcminute VST field contains the full bright optical disk. The larger warped neutral-hydrogen outskirts are not represented. This ledger consolidates existing records; no fresh source survey or visual qualification was performed.

entries.subject: Parametric image-layer geometry
entries.finding: The observation is decomposed by local compactness into one high-frequency midplane residual and a diffuse component. Only diffuse optical depth is distributed through 32 normalized parametric slabs; cross-axis textures sample the same separable field. This is not measured per-pixel depth. Adopted thickness: 1.2 kpc. The cited geometry reference is Corbelli et al. 2014, arXiv:1409.2665. Selection does not independently qualify those adopted values.

entries.subject: Source fields, coordinate registration and depth evidence
entries.finding: The retained records identify geometry references but do not preserve exact paper table/section locators, uncertainty and coordinate epoch for every adopted placement or orientation value. Observation dates and an independent crop/sky registration comparison are not recorded. No measured three-dimensional reconstruction is established.
entries.revisitWhen: A qualification task supplies the original metadata or paper fields and an independent registration comparison for these exact inputs.
